DECLARE @CPSUI_VERIFIED_DAYS_BACK INT = @0
DECLARE @MEMBERLIST_IID BIGINT = 0
DECLARE @FILENAME VARCHAR(50) = @1
DECLARE @PROCESSIND VARCHAR(20) = @2
DECLARE @RECORDS BIGINT
--UPDATED SNOW-57348

IF (@PROCESSIND = 'RECENTLISTS')
BEGIN 
        DECLARE @CALLLISTDATE_DELTA DATETIME
		SELECT @CALLLISTDATE_DELTA = DATEADD(MINUTE,-5,MAX(CALLLISTDATE_DATE)) FROM PDS_CALLLISTDATE
		
		CREATE TABLE #tmp_CPSUI_MembersRecent (PHONE VARCHAR(20))
		INSERT INTO #tmp_CPSUI_MembersRecent (PHONE)
		SELECT MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE
		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID= CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
				AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE > @CALLLISTDATE_DELTA
				AND CALLLISTTYPE_IID NOT IN (3,10)
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
			INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_IID=CASE WHEN CL.CALLLIST_CD IN ('331','332','333','512','513','514') THEN CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID ELSE CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID END
			INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE <> ''
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE IS NOT NULL
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE LIKE '[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
			INNER JOIN PDS_VALIDPHONEAREACODE AC ON AC.VALIDPHONEAREACODE_AREACODE = LEFT(MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE,3)
		GROUP BY MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE

		UNION

		SELECT M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber
		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID= CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
				AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE > @CALLLISTDATE_DELTA
				AND CALLLISTTYPE_IID = 10
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
			INNER JOIN PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M ON M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_IID= CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber <> ''
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber IS NOT NULL
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber LIKE '[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
			INNER JOIN PDS_VALIDPHONEAREACODE AC ON AC.VALIDPHONEAREACODE_AREACODE = LEFT(M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber,3)
		GROUP BY M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber

		UNION

		SELECT M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2
		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID= CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID
				AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE > @CALLLISTDATE_DELTA
				AND CALLLISTTYPE_IID = 10
			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
			INNER JOIN PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M ON M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_IID= CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2 <> ''
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2 IS NOT NULL
				AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2 LIKE '[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
			INNER JOIN PDS_VALIDPHONEAREACODE AC ON AC.VALIDPHONEAREACODE_AREACODE = LEFT(M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2,3)
		GROUP BY M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2

		--DECLARE @RECORDS BIGINT

		SELECT @RECORDS = COUNT(PHONE) FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersRecent

		IF @RECORDS > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) 
			VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,@FILENAME);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE)
			SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,-1,M.PHONE
			FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersRecent M
		END

		SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID
END

IF (@PROCESSIND = 'CAREGUIDE')
BEGIN 
		
		CREATE TABLE #tmp_CPSUI_MembersCareGuide (PHONE VARCHAR(20))
		INSERT INTO #tmp_CPSUI_MembersCareGuide (PHONE)
		SELECT M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber
		FROM PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M
		WHERE M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_CreateDate > (CAST(GETDATE()-1 AS DATE))
			AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber IS NOT NULL
			AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber <> ''
		GROUP BY M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber

		UNION

		SELECT M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2
		FROM PDS_CAREGUIDE_MEMBER M
		WHERE M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_CreateDate > (CAST(GETDATE()-1 AS DATE))
			AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2 IS NOT NULL
			AND M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2 <> ''
		GROUP BY M.CAREGUIDE_MEMBER_PhoneNumber2

		--DECLARE @RECORDS BIGINT

		SELECT @RECORDS = COUNT(PHONE) FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersCareGuide

		IF @RECORDS > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,@FILENAME);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE)
			SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,-1,M.PHONE
			FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersCareGuide M
		END

		SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID
END

IF (@PROCESSIND = 'AUTO')
BEGIN 
        
		CREATE TABLE #tmp_CPSUI_Members (PHONE VARCHAR(20))
		INSERT INTO #tmp_CPSUI_Members (PHONE)
		SELECT TOP 400000 MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE
		FROM PDS_MEMBER M
			INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON M.MEMBER_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID
				--AND M.MEMBER_MCARE_ELIGIBILITY_IND = 1
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_CPSUI_VERIFIED_DT <DATEADD(DAY,@CPSUI_VERIFIED_DAYS_BACK,GETDATE())
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE IS NOT NULL
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE <> ''
				--AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 -- SNOW-27916
				AND MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID <>2
			LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER CMM ON  
					CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE = MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE
				AND CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID IN (SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		WHERE CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE is null
		AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE NOT IN (SELECT [DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER] FROM PDS_DONOTCAlLPHONE WHERE DONOTCALLPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		GROUP BY MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE

		--DECLARE @RECORDS BIGINT

		SELECT @RECORDS = COUNT(PHONE) FROM #tmp_CPSUI_Members

		IF @RECORDS > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,@FILENAME);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE)
			SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,-1,M.PHONE
			FROM #tmp_CPSUI_Members M
		END

		SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID
END

IF (@PROCESSIND = 'MANUALFILES')
BEGIN 

		CREATE TABLE #tmp_CPSUI_MembersMANUAL (PHONE VARCHAR(20))
		INSERT INTO #tmp_CPSUI_MembersMANUAL (PHONE)
		SELECT MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE
		FROM PDS_MEMBER M
			INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON M.MEMBER_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID
				--AND M.MEMBER_MCARE_ELIGIBILITY_IND
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_CPSUI_VERIFIED_DT <DATEADD(DAY,@CPSUI_VERIFIED_DAYS_BACK,GETDATE())
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE IS NOT NULL
				AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE <> ''
				--AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 -- SNOW-27916
				AND MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID <>2
				AND MEMBERPHONE_CREATE_DT > (CAST(GETDATE()-1 AS DATE))
			LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER CMM ON
					CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE = MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE
				AND CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID IN (SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		WHERE CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE is null
		AND MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE NOT IN 
		(SELECT [DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER] FROM PDS_DONOTCAlLPHONE WHERE DONOTCALLPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		GROUP BY MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE


		SELECT @RECORDS = COUNT(PHONE) FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersMANUAL

		IF @RECORDS > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) 
			VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,@FILENAME);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,
			CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE)
			SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,-1,M.PHONE
			FROM #tmp_CPSUI_MembersMANUAL M
		END

		SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID
END

IF (@PROCESSIND = 'DESIGNEE')   -- SNOW-62176
BEGIN
		
		CREATE TABLE #tmp_CPSUI_Designee (PHONE VARCHAR(20))
		INSERT INTO #tmp_CPSUI_Designee (PHONE)
		SELECT DP.DESG_PHONENUMBER
		FROM PDS_DESIGNEE_PHONENUMBER DP
		LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER CMM ON
					CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE = DP.DESG_PHONENUMBER
				AND CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID IN (SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		WHERE CMM.CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE is null
		--AND S.FILEIMPORT_IID IN (SELECT FILEIMPORT_IID FROM PDS_FILEIMPORT 
		--							WHERE CAST(FILEIMPORT_IMPORTDATE AS DATE) >= (CASE WHEN DATENAME(DW, GETDATE()) = 'Monday' THEN 
		--							(CAST(GETDATE()-2 AS DATE)) ELSE (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) END 
		--						))
		--AND DP.DESG_PHONENUMBER NOT IN 
		--(SELECT [DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER] FROM PDS_DONOTCAlLPHONE WHERE DONOTCALLPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1)
		GROUP BY DP.DESG_PHONENUMBER

		
		SELECT @RECORDS = COUNT(PHONE) FROM #tmp_CPSUI_Designee

		IF @RECORDS > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST (CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_DATE,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_CREATE_USER,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_ACTIVE_IND,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_FILENAME) 
			VALUES (GETDATE(),USER_NAME(),1,@FILENAME);SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

			INSERT INTO PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER(CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID,
			CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBER_IID,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE)
			SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID,-1,D.PHONE
			FROM #tmp_CPSUI_Designee D
		END

		SELECT @MEMBERLIST_IID

END
